close_reason: Made the source invariant (at least one of href or blob_id MUST be set, both MAY be) explicit in struct-level rustdoc and added Link::validate_source() returning Result<(), LinkSourceError> as an opt-in check. Chose not to encode the invariant via enum LinkSource because (a) it would be breaking for a pre-1.0 sub-type crate, (b) it would block partial-construction patterns for in-flight updates, (c) draft §5.3 wording leans-exclusive but is not explicitly exclusive so the 'both set' case is permitted. The opt-in helper plus discoverable rustdoc is the minimal-blast-radius fix. Added link_validate_source_enforces_invariant test with 4 cases (href-only, blob-only, both, neither) all using independent JSON oracle. cargo test + cargo clippy -D warnings clean.
title: Link.href: Option<String> and Link.blob_id: Option<Id> are both Optional but RFC 8984 §1.4.11 requires one of them to be present — every consumer must defensively check
